method: Automated source inspection by the coordinating assistant and a separate subagent; reference facts checked before reading the live review, then all four findings checked afterwards. Not human expert review or an independent-model voting ensemble.

checks.detail: Floor and truncation each agree across 13 datasets. Nearest rounding differs in all five metrics. Floor correlation is -0.07; truncation is -0.06.
Website prints R=0.06 without a plus glyph; its positive meaning conflicts with all negative dataset correlations. Paper Figure 6 prints -0.06.

1000 proposals, 687 accepted, 313 rejected, 142 points moved. Acceptance constraint passes. Selected extracted functions and adapted bounded loop, not a full original-package or convergence reproduction.
No evidence for all experiments, animations, historical random sequences or performance reproduction.
